comment: Turns on the persistent shopping cart, which remembers a customer's session across visits.
modal: When **Yes**, Magento keeps a persistent session for returning customers so their cart and related data are remembered between visits. Can be set per website.

comment: How long, in seconds, the persistent session is kept.
modal: The lifetime of the persistent session, in seconds. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is set to Yes. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether a Remember Me checkbox is shown on the login and registration forms.
modal: When **Yes**, a **Remember Me** checkbox is displayed on the login and registration forms, letting customers opt into a persistent session. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is Yes.

comment: Whether the Remember Me checkbox is ticked by default.
modal: Sets the default state of the **Remember Me** checkbox: **Yes** pre-ticks it, **No** leaves it unchecked. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is Yes.

comment: Whether the persistent session is cleared when the customer signs out.
modal: When **Yes**, the persistent session is cleared when the customer signs out; when **No**, it persists after sign out. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is Yes.

comment: Whether the shopping cart contents are retained in the persistent session.
modal: When **Yes**, the contents of the shopping cart are kept as part of the persistent session between visits. Applies only when **Enable Persistence** is Yes.
